definition: Aesthetic rupture/relish — the apprehension in which only pleasure appears. The moment of rasa-experience: a break in ordinary cognition where the self is suffused with aesthetic delight. Not an emotion but the relish of an emotion made universal.

sources.claim: camatkāra as the rupture in which only pleasure (ānanda) appears — the defining moment of rasa-experience

translations.note: 'Aesthetic rupture' captures the break in ordinary cognition; 'relish' captures the enjoyment; 'wonder' is the closest emotional equivalent.
